scope.comparison: Matched baseline/candidate whole compositions, then visible foam-tip details against unchanged canonical scan.

identity.referenceSourceAndCaptureHashes: verified once against receipt; frozen source copies match live source

localFinding: Short interior marks visibly reduce blank tips and clarify their recurvature. Gain is modest across all three seeds; seed0 has the clearest change. Parallel marks also duplicate outer tip curvature and remain diagrammatic rather than convincing folds.
wholeCrest: Unchanged recognition. Sparse tip count, broad blank cap and long uninterrupted cream tongue remain unlike the canonical branching foam hierarchy. Water silhouette and bands are unchanged.
materialStyle: Unchanged flat vector appearance. Uniform thin ink and smooth parallel blue bands do not establish woodblock material or source style; clouds unchanged.
technicalEvidence: Worker reports 51 children over eight fixtures contained and pair-separated; this review did not rerun checks or infer visual generality from them.
userAcceptance: Untested; no accepted procedural artwork established.
nextDecision: Adopt creases in the research gallery as a minor articulation improvement, retain the no-ink switch, and move the next geometry hypothesis to branching hierarchy and interrupted foam mass rather than further crease tuning.

accounting.note: Startup context and oversized worker-checks output exceeded the intended evaluator budget; no broad reruns performed.
